name: thurbox-fleetlens
description: Browse Fleet v2 resources, Tasks first, in a read-only keyboard-first float.
author: Thurbeen
install:
thurbox-cli plugin install git+https://github.com/Thurbeen/thurbox-fleetlens
thurbox-cli plugin check
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.76.2 and Fleet v2, whose fleet binary ships for Linux. Trust the pane to run fleet: Settings (Ctrl+,), then ], select thurbox-fleetlens/plugins/88_fleet_lens.lua and press t. Alt+K opens it. Read-only. The fleetlens settings choose the fleet binary, its config, and the host it runs on (POSIX only).

media.alt: Fleet Lens in the Doom theme: Alt+K opens it on four Tasks, the one that needs attention on top, enter reads a shipped Task as YAML and tab steps to the ChangeRequest it declared

name: thurbox-info-panel
description: Session, git, agent, account quota and system readouts beside your terminal.
author: Thurbeen
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.51.7. Add the info slot to layout.lua, then press F2. Account quotas need quota-axi ≥ 0.1.58 and a run grant; install the optional refresh extension from the cloned plugin directory. See README for setup.

media.alt: Info panel in the Thurbox interface

name: thurbox-auto-continue
description: Resume Claude sessions once their usage window resets.
author: Thurbeen
notes: Requires cargo or a prebuilt binary, Claude Code and Thurbox ≥ 2.36.2. Off by default. Follow the README to install both optional panes and grant run. Native Windows unsupported.

media.alt: Auto continue in the Thurbox interface

name: thurbox-code-review
description: Review worktree diffs and send numbered notes to your agent.
author: Thurbeen
platforms: Windows (Lua pane; optional shell commands need a POSIX shell)
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.35.0. Replaces the bundled agent pane; follow README setup and capability grants. Cannot combine with the thurbox-files agent pane fork.

media.alt: Code review in the Thurbox interface

name: thurbox-doom
description: Play DOOM in an agent-pane tab, with a bundled engine and WADs.
author: Thurbeen
platforms: Other platforms (bring or build an engine)
notes: Install code-review for the integrated Doom tab, then grant its agent pane program. F5 opens Doom. GIF shows the earlier standalone pane; README documents current setup.

name: thurbox-automations
description: Manage automations and read their recent runs: create, edit, duplicate, switch on and off, run now and delete.
author: Thurbeen
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.56.5; creating, editing, duplicating and switching back on need ≥ 2.57.0. No layout.lua edit. Alt+A opens it. Trust the pane (run) only to write exec automations' commands. Run history is the 10 most recent runs, and an exec run keeps only its output tail.

media.alt: The automations pane in the Doom theme: the list, a failed run's output filtered to errors, run now, an automation switched off and a delete confirmed

name: thurbox-voice
description: Dictate a prompt into the selected session with Ctrl+Space. Speech is transcribed on your machine, and the text waits unsent.
author: TMSCH
install:
git clone https://github.com/TMSCH/thurbox-voice && cd thurbox-voice
cargo install --locked --path crates/thurbox-voice
thurbox-voice pull parakeet
thurbox-cli plugin install git+https://github.com/TMSCH/thurbox-voice
thurbox-cli plugin check
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.56.0, Rust and cmake; Linux also needs pkg-config and ALSA headers. Trust the voice pane to run its helper. Audio stays local. An optional cleanup pass, on by default, sends the transcript and session context to a language model, hosted unless you point it at a local server. See README.

media.alt: Dictating into a Thurbox session: Ctrl+Space, speak, Ctrl+Space, and the text waits in the input box

name: thurbox-files
description: Browse files and changes, with editor and diff tabs beside the agent.
author: spscream
platforms: Other platforms (POSIX tools and nvim required; unverified)
install:
thurbox-cli plugin install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as plugins/90_files.lua
thurbox-cli plugin install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as plugins/95_files_menu.lua
thurbox-cli plugin install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as plugins/20_agent.lua
notes: Follow the README to replace the bundled agent pane, place the files slot in layout.lua and grant capabilities. Requires nvim. Conflicts with the code-review agent pane fork.

name: thurbox-annotate
description: Annotate captured agent output, or collect notes on a live selection.
author: spscream
platforms: Windows / WSL (Lite clipboard support; Full requires POSIX scripts)
notes: Shown command installs Lite; requires Thurbox ≥ 2.25.0. Grant run for agent clipboard selection. Full uses plannotator-tui and the program capability; see README for its installer. F2 opens Lite; GIF shows Full.
